_meta.indication: VIEKIRA PAK with or without ribavirin is indicated for the treatment of patients with genotype 1 chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection including those with compensated cirrhosis

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial; subjects without cirrhosis randomized to VIEKIRA PAK plus ribavirin for 12 weeks or placebo
pivotal_trials.population: Genotype 1 (a and b) treatment-naive adults without cirrhosis
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was SVR12 (HCV RNA below the lower limit of quantification 12 weeks after end of treatment); non-inferiority and superiority to the historical rate for telaprevir plus pegIFN/RBV
pivotal_trials.n: 473 treated with VIEKIRA PAK + RBV; 158 placebo
pivotal_trials.result: SVR12 achieved by 455/473 (96%) subjects, 95% CI 94.5% to 97.9%; lower confidence bound above 80%, meeting both non-inferiority (LCB >70%) and superiority (LCB >80%) thresholds

key_safety: With ribavirin, most common adverse reactions (>10%) were fatigue (34% vs 26% placebo), nausea (22% vs 15%), pruritus (18% vs 7%), skin reactions (16% vs 9%), insomnia (14% vs 8%) and asthenia (14% vs 7%). ALT elevations >5x ULN occurred in approximately 1% of subjects, more frequent in women using ethinyl estradiol-containing medications.
target_moa: Fixed combination of direct-acting antivirals: ombitasvir, an HCV NS5A inhibitor; paritaprevir, an HCV NS3/4A protease inhibitor; ritonavir, a CYP3A inhibitor that boosts paritaprevir; and dasabuvir, a non-nucleoside HCV NS5B palm polymerase inhibitor
modality: Small molecule (co-packaged combination of direct-acting antivirals)

rems.type: A formal Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) is not required; a Medication Guide was deemed necessary instead

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held because the product was designated Breakthrough and there were no major issues needing additional advisory committee input
